components.css: .ds-setup{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:96px 24px 24px;background:#080e1c;color:#f5f4fa;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-setup-band{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:76px;border-radius:0 0 50% 50% / 0 0 16% 16%;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#087fba35,#19225520 45%,#a3246d30);border-bottom:1px solid #b4cfff;box-shadow:0 9px 25px -17px #63baff}.ds-setup-stage{position:relative;display:grid;min-height:180px;place-items:center;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid transparent;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#18324c85,#0b1025b8 48%,#311a3b80);background-clip:padding-box;box-shadow:0 22px 55px -32px #000;backdrop-filter:blur(22px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px)}.ds-setup-stage::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit;padding:1px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#42bfff,#67edd4 25%,#8d9bff 55%,#ff7bdf 80%,#ffd9a3);mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);mask-composite:exclude}.ds-setup-choice{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:44px;margin-top:12px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #a6dfff;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#123957dc,#302345dc);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer}.ds-setup-choice:hover{border-color:#b2c8e7}.ds-setup-choice:focus-within{outline:3px solid #d3b0ff;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The implemented workspace uses a dark canvas, subtly separated panels, pale lavender actions, and compact sans-serif typography. Discover's role cards establish the shared visual vocabulary used by forms, application lists, and onboarding.

This is a description of the incumbent React UI, not a new brand direction. Source authority is `next-app/app/globals.css`, `next-app/components/ui.jsx`, `role-card.jsx`, and `app-shell.jsx`; the legacy root static UI is not the deployed visual reference.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender primary actions and active navigation.
Rounded controls with generous touch targets.
Wrapping layouts and responsive content grids.

rules.name: Onboarding surface exception
rules.body: Only .setup-experience uses the user-approved static rainbow glass treatment: near-black navy, a curved illuminated upper band, translucent blue controls, rainbow stage edges, solid white/cool-gray text, and cyan selection. No motion. Shared workspace palette, surfaces, and component tokens remain unchanged.

dos: Do reuse the shared color tokens and `ui.jsx` controls.
Do retain the global focus indicator, 44px minimum control height, wrapping behavior, and reduced-motion handling.
Do use surface tones and borders to separate shared panels.
donts: Don't use the legacy root static UI as the reference for new React screens.
Don't replace data-driven rarity accents with primary action styling.
